title: A gated command that carries an inline secret cannot be approved: add an out-of-band way to review it without storing the secret
impact: Since the redaction fix (F14, F18) a gated command is stored redacted. A human cannot verify what the plan hash covers from a redacted text, so permits.approve refuses and the agent is told to move the secret into an environment variable or a file.
